description: This file defines a Go package 'automaxprocs' that handles parsing and representing mount point information from Linux's /proc/$PID/mountinfo, including data structures, parsing functions, and path translation methods.

classes.name: MountPoint
classes.description: Data structure representing a Linux mount point with fields for IDs, device info, mount paths, options, filesystem type, and superblock options.

methods.name: NewMountPointFromLine
methods.description: Parses a line from /proc/$PID/mountinfo and returns a MountPoint object.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Converts an absolute path inside the mount point's filesystem to the host filesystem path.

methods.name: parseMountInfo
methods.description: Reads and parses the mountinfo file, invoking a callback for each parsed MountPoint.
